states.name: after_check_1
states.description: Avocado models are loaded and arranged in a circular pattern (at least 6 avocados visible in the scene)

states.name: after_check_2
states.description: Lantern model is loaded and visible, positioned above the avocado arrangement as a floating light source

states.name: after_check_3
states.description: A PointLight or SpotLight is attached to or near the lantern, casting colored dynamic light onto the scene

states.name: after_check_4
states.description: HSL hue slider, intensity slider, range slider, and Paint button UI controls are present in the DOM

states.name: after_check_5
states.description: Adjusting the hue slider changes the lantern's light color in real time

states.name: after_check_6
states.description: Clicking an avocado selects it, visually indicating selection (e.g. outline, emissive highlight, or tracked in state)

states.name: after_check_7
states.description: Pressing the Paint button permanently tints the selected avocado(s) with the lantern's current light color

states.name: after_check_8
states.description: Painted avocados retain their color permanently and do not revert when the lantern color changes afterward

states.name: after_check_9
states.description: A validation mechanism exists to check if all avocados are painted in the correct rainbow sequence (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet)

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["avocado","multi","asset","graphics"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()
